text: Nova shipped her app today. Two hundred views.
Across town, Theo's launch ad hit forty thousand by lunch.
His app does half of what hers does.
Theo just grins. Views are views, he says. Speed wins.
Then Blip beeps. People don't share apps. They share stories.
So her story is the bug that almost killed it?
Theo says post a clean demo. Nobody cares about bugs.
Three nights. One bug. Nova almost quit.
Blip is sure. That is the story. Show the night she almost quit.
One post tonight. Tomorrow, they count.
Comment A for the demo, or B for the story.
